sentences.en: His face was red and he felt hot and uncomfortable.
sentences.zh: 他的脸红了，感觉又热又不舒服。

sentences.en: I felt uncomfortable with those kids loitering around in the train.
sentences.zh: 我觉得那些孩子在火车上闲逛很不舒服。

sentences.en: It is uncomfortable to be sitting on this chair.
sentences.zh: 坐在这个椅子上很不舒服。

senses.zh: 不舒服的令人不舒服的;令人不舒适的不安的;不自在的
